title: 离心机的安全使用
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/121_离心机的安全使用.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/121_离心机的安全使用/src.py

points.K1: 离心机的危害：转子失效、失衡、气溶胶
points.K2: 先培训、穿防护，拿不准就问
points.K3: 按需选机，只用配套转子
points.K4: 离心管匹配、完好、不过满
points.K5: 放稳机身，腔体干净，转子落座
points.K6: 配平：质量相等，差一点也不行
points.K7: 对称放置，单个样品做配平管
points.K9: 核对转速和时间，超载要降速
points.K11: 运行异常：立即停机，人员远离
points.K14: 感染性材料：密封离心，柜内装卸
points.K15: 用后擦干登记，故障停用报告

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排离心机前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a row of benchtop centrifuges with lids closed, smiling at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：离心机的安全使用。

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣模仿转子飞快旋转
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot spins one paw in a fast circle to mimic a rotor turning at high speed.
shots.narration: 转得越快，越要守规矩。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一支样品管走向离心机
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks to a benchtop centrifuge holding a single sample tube, looking hurried.
shots.narration: 阿杰赶时间，只有一管样品要离心。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 他把单管放进转子就要关盖
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one tube placed alone in a rotor and a hand about to close the centrifuge lid, a question mark above. No text.
shots.narration: 没配平，盖子也没拧，就想开机。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 离心机剧烈抖动，阿杰愣住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a benchtop centrifuge shaking violently on the bench with motion lines and a startled student stepping back. No text.
shots.narration: 机器一下子剧烈抖动起来。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研按下停止键，示意后退
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses the stop button and gestures the young male student to step back.
shots.narration: 小研按下停止：先停机，人退开！

shots.section_title: 离心机的危害：转子失效、失衡、气溶胶
shots.scene: 飞轮和离心机转子并排，能量图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a heavy flywheel next to a centrifuge rotor, both with a large energy symbol above them. No text.
shots.narration: 高速转子像飞轮，储存着巨大能量。
overlay: 离心机的危害：转子失效、失衡、气溶胶

shots.section_title: 离心机的危害：转子失效、失衡、气溶胶
shots.scene: 离心管里重的沉底、轻的在上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spinning tube where heavy particles move to the bottom and lighter liquid stays on top. No text.
shots.narration: 它靠离心力，把轻重不同的成分分开。

shots.section_title: 离心机的危害：转子失效、失衡、气溶胶
shots.scene: 腐蚀的旧转子断裂，碎片打穿机壳，人员疏散，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an old corroded rotor breaking apart inside a centrifuge, fragments punching through the casing and people evacuating the building, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 老化转子加上一时匆忙，就会出大事。

shots.section_title: 离心机的危害：转子失效、失衡、气溶胶
shots.scene: 转子失效、失衡、气溶胶三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a cracked rotor, a tilted unbalanced rotor and a cloud of tiny droplets. No text.
shots.narration: 三大危害：转子失效、失衡、气溶胶。

shots.section_title: 离心机的危害：转子失效、失衡、气溶胶
shots.scene: 人的手势图标上打问号，多数事故源于操作
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pie chart with the largest slice marked by a hand icon representing human error. No text.
shots.narration: 离心事故，大多出在操作失误上。

shots.section_title: 先培训、穿防护，拿不准就问
shots.scene: 王老师给新生讲离心机操作规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator trains new students beside a centrifuge, holding a blank operating procedure card.
shots.narration: 第一次用，先培训考核，读懂规程。
overlay: 先培训、穿防护，拿不准就问

shots.section_title: 先培训、穿防护，拿不准就问
shots.scene: 大型和超速离心机旁的空白授权名单和登记本
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a floor standing high speed centrifuge with a blank authorised user list and a usage logbook beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 大型、超速离心机，授权使用、登记。

shots.section_title: 先培训、穿防护，拿不准就问
shots.scene: 小研穿实验服、长裤、全包鞋，戴护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a lab coat, long trousers, closed shoes, safety goggles and gloves before using the centrifuge.
shots.narration: 实验服、长裤、全包鞋、护目镜、手套。

shots.section_title: 先培训、穿防护，拿不准就问
shots.scene: 说明书、问老师两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, an open manual and a student asking a teacher a question. No text.
shots.narration: 拿不准转子和管子，先查说明书、问老师。

shots.section_title: 先培训、穿防护，拿不准就问
shots.scene: 短视频图标加培训证书，视频不能代替培训
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a short video icon with an equals sign crossed out next to a training certificate. No text.
shots.narration: 看视频不能代替正式培训。

shots.section_title: 按需选机，只用配套转子
shots.scene: 微量、台式温控、落地高速三种离心机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three kinds of centrifuges side by side, a small micro centrifuge, a refrigerated benchtop centrifuge and a large floor standing high speed centrifuge. No text.
shots.narration: 离心机有大有小，用途不同。
overlay: 按需选机，只用配套转子

shots.section_title: 按需选机，只用配套转子
shots.scene: 按转速、管子大小、样品量三个图标选机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a speed gauge, tubes of different sizes and a sample volume scale, pointing to the right centrifuge. No text.
shots.narration: 按转速、管子大小和样品量来选。

shots.section_title: 按需选机，只用配套转子
shots.scene: 转子和离心机型号对应，混用打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rotor fitting its own centrifuge with a tick, and a rotor from another machine crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 只用这台离心机配套的转子。

shots.section_title: 按需选机，只用配套转子
shots.scene: 转子上的最高转速和最大载荷图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rotor with two icons beside it, a maximum speed gauge and a maximum load weight. No text.
shots.narration: 每个转子都有最高转速和载荷上限。

shots.section_title: 离心管匹配、完好、不过满
shots.scene: 离心管与转子孔大小匹配，太大太小打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tube fitting a rotor hole exactly with a tick, a tube too big and a tube too loose crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 离心管要和转子孔、离心机配套。
overlay: 离心管匹配、完好、不过满

shots.section_title: 离心管匹配、完好、不过满
shots.scene: 【实拍】把 0.5 毫升小管套进适配器，再放入转子孔位（空管）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: gloved fingers slipping a small tube into an adapter and then placing the adapter into a rotor hole.
shots.narration: 小管先套适配器，再放进孔位。

shots.section_title: 离心管匹配、完好、不过满
shots.scene: 管壁有裂纹、变形的管子打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tube with a crack and a deformed tube, both crossed out, next to an intact tube with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 用前查管子：有裂纹、变形不用。

shots.section_title: 离心管匹配、完好、不过满
shots.scene: 角转子里液面被甩向管口，装满溢出，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: in an angle rotor the liquid surface tilts toward the tube mouth, an overfilled tube leaking out, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不要装太满，大管约八成。

shots.section_title: 离心管匹配、完好、不过满
shots.scene: 拧紧管盖
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: gloved fingers screwing a tube cap on tightly.
shots.narration: 管盖盖紧，防止甩出漏液。

shots.section_title: 放稳机身，腔体干净，转子落座
shots.scene: 离心机放在稳固水平的台面上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a centrifuge standing on a solid level bench with a bubble level icon and free space around it. No text.
shots.narration: 离心机放在稳固、水平的台面上。
overlay: 放稳机身，腔体干净，转子落座

shots.section_title: 放稳机身，腔体干净，转子落座
shots.scene: 腔体干燥干净、驱动轴干净
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clean dry centrifuge chamber and a clean drive shaft in the middle, a cloth icon beside. No text.
shots.narration: 腔体要干，驱动轴要净。

shots.section_title: 放稳机身，腔体干净，转子落座
shots.scene: 【实拍】转子稳稳放到驱动轴上，确认落座到底
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: two hands lowering a rotor straight onto the drive shaft until it seats fully.
shots.narration: 转子放正放到底，不歪不悬。

shots.section_title: 放稳机身，腔体干净，转子落座
shots.scene: 吊篮挂好，能自由摆动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: swing buckets hanging on a swing out rotor, each moving freely on its pivot. No text.
shots.narration: 水平转子：吊篮挂好，摆动自如。

shots.section_title: 放稳机身，腔体干净，转子落座
shots.scene: 转子裂纹腐蚀、密封圈破损，停用打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rotor with a crack and corrosion spots and a damaged rubber seal ring, with a stop symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 转子有裂纹腐蚀、密封圈坏了，停用。

shots.section_title: 配平：质量相等，差一点也不行
shots.scene: 两管液面一高一低，天平倾斜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two tubes with different liquid levels and a tilted balance scale above them. No text.
shots.narration: 离心管必须配平。
overlay: 配平：质量相等，差一点也不行

shots.section_title: 配平：质量相等，差一点也不行
shots.scene: 【实拍】在天平上称离心管，补液到质量相等（清水）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a tube in a holder on a lab balance while a pipette adds water to the paired tube until both weigh the same.
shots.narration: 称重配平，质量要相等。

shots.section_title: 配平：质量相等，差一点也不行
shots.scene: 同种溶液小管，体积一致即可
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two small tubes of the same solution with equal liquid levels and a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 同种溶液的小管，体积一致即可。

shots.section_title: 配平：质量相等，差一点也不行
shots.scene: 大体积、不同溶液必须称，配平液接近样品
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: large bottles and two different coloured solutions placed on a balance, a matching balance liquid beside them. No text.
shots.narration: 大体积或溶液轻重不同，要用天平称。

shots.section_title: 配平：质量相等，差一点也不行
shots.scene: 小砝码在高速下被放大成巨大的力
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tiny weight on one side of a spinning rotor growing into a huge arrow of force. No text.
shots.narration: 差半克，高速下也会放大成巨大的力。

shots.section_title: 配平：质量相等，差一点也不行
shots.scene: 超速离心机旁，精密天平
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ultracentrifuge beside a precision balance with a careful hand. No text.
shots.narration: 超速离心，配平要格外精确。

shots.section_title: 对称放置，单个样品做配平管
shots.scene: 两管放在转子正对的位置，挨着放打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two tubes placed in opposite holes of a rotor with a tick, two tubes side by side on one half crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 两管放在正对面，不能挨着放。
overlay: 对称放置，单个样品做配平管

shots.section_title: 对称放置，单个样品做配平管
shots.scene: 【实拍】把样品管和配平管放入转子正对的孔位（清水管）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: gloved fingers placing a sample tube and its balance tube into exactly opposite holes of a rotor.
shots.narration: 只有一管样品，做一支等重的配平管。

shots.section_title: 对称放置，单个样品做配平管
shots.scene: 多管按等分位置对称排列
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rotor seen from above with six tubes spaced evenly like a star, and three tubes evenly spaced as a triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 管子多时，按等分位置对称摆放。

shots.section_title: 对称放置，单个样品做配平管
shots.scene: 吊篮和适配器成对对称
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: swing buckets and adapters loaded in matching pairs on opposite sides of a rotor. No text.
shots.narration: 吊篮、适配器也要成对对称。

shots.section_title: 拧紧转子盖，锁好机盖
shots.scene: 【实拍】盖上转子盖并拧紧，再检查固定
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands placing the rotor lid on the rotor and turning the knob until it is tight.
shots.narration: 盖上转子盖并拧紧，漏了也不外溅。

shots.section_title: 拧紧转子盖，锁好机盖
shots.scene: 没固定、没盖、没拧紧三个打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three crossed out icons, a loose rotor, a rotor without a lid and a half screwed lid. No text.
shots.narration: 没固定、没盖、没拧紧，最常见。

shots.section_title: 拧紧转子盖，锁好机盖
shots.scene: 关上机盖，听到锁扣声，联锁图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a centrifuge lid closing with a click symbol and a lock icon showing the interlock engaged. No text.
shots.narration: 关好机盖锁紧，联锁起作用才能转。

shots.section_title: 拧紧转子盖，锁好机盖
shots.scene: 转子盖松脱飞出，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a loose rotor lid flying off inside a spinning centrifuge, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 转子盖松了，高速下会脱出。

shots.section_title: 核对转速和时间，超载要降速
shots.scene: 【实拍】控制面板上设定转速和时间（遮挡品牌）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a finger setting speed and time on a blank centrifuge control panel.
shots.narration: 开机前核对转速和时间，按方案设。
overlay: 核对转速和时间，超载要降速

shots.section_title: 核对转速和时间，超载要降速
shots.scene: 转速和离心力两个单位图标，选对单位
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a speed dial and a gravity force arrow, a hand choosing one before setting. No text.
shots.narration: 先选按离心力还是按转速设定。

shots.section_title: 核对转速和时间，超载要降速
shots.scene: 设定值不超过管子和转子的上限
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a speed gauge with the needle below a red limit line marked by a tube icon and a rotor icon. No text.
shots.narration: 不超过管子和转子允许的最高转速。

shots.section_title: 核对转速和时间，超载要降速
shots.scene: 装载超重，转速表指针下调
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a heavy loaded rotor on a scale and a speed gauge needle being turned down. No text.
shots.narration: 装载超过上限，按说明书降速。

shots.section_title: 守到全速平稳再离开
shots.scene: 按启动键，人站在旁边看转速上升
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses start and stands beside the centrifuge watching the speed rise.
shots.narration: 按下启动，先别走开。

shots.section_title: 守到全速平稳再离开
shots.scene: 显示达到设定转速，机器平稳
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a centrifuge running smoothly with a gauge reaching the set mark and a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 守到平稳达到设定转速，再离开。

shots.section_title: 守到全速平稳再离开
shots.scene: 机盖上放东西、人倚靠，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bottle placed on a running centrifuge lid and a person leaning on it, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 运行时不倚靠，机盖上不放东西。

shots.section_title: 运行异常：立即停机，人员远离
shots.scene: 离心机晃动，手按停止键
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shaking centrifuge with motion lines and a finger pressing the stop button. No text.
shots.narration: 异响、晃动、报警，立即按停止。
overlay: 运行异常：立即停机，人员远离

shots.section_title: 运行异常：立即停机，人员远离
shots.scene: 必要时拔插头断电，人员后退
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand switching off the power at the wall and people stepping away from the centrifuge. No text.
shots.narration: 必要时切断电源，人员先远离。

shots.section_title: 运行异常：立即停机，人员远离
shots.scene: 用手、工具刹转子，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand and a screwdriver trying to stop a spinning rotor, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 绝不用手或工具强行刹停转子。

shots.section_title: 运行异常：立即停机，人员远离
shots.scene: 晃动多半因为没配平
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an unbalanced rotor with one heavy side, broken tube and damaged rotor icons around it. No text.
shots.narration: 晃动多半是没配平，会破管、伤人。

shots.section_title: 运行异常：立即停机，人员远离
shots.scene: 停稳后挂停用牌，报告老师
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stopped centrifuge with a blank out of service tag and a phone call to the lab supervisor. No text.
shots.narration: 停稳后挂牌停用，报告检修。

shots.section_title: 完全停稳再开盖
shots.scene: 断电后转子靠惯性继续转
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rotor still spinning after the power is cut, slowing down gradually with fading motion lines. No text.
shots.narration: 断电后，转子还会靠惯性转很久。

shots.section_title: 完全停稳再开盖
shots.scene: 转子没停就掀盖，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand lifting the lid while the rotor is still spinning, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 转子没停稳，绝不开盖。

shots.section_title: 完全停稳再开盖
shots.scene: 显示归零，盖子解锁后打开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a speed display at zero and a lid unlocking symbol, then the lid opening. No text.
shots.narration: 完全停止、盖子解锁，再打开。

shots.section_title: 完全停稳再开盖
shots.scene: 慢慢拧开转子盖，轻拿样品管
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands slowly unscrewing the rotor lid and lifting out a tube gently.
shots.narration: 慢慢拧开转子盖，轻拿样品管。

shots.section_title: 开盖查漏，破管不徒手
shots.scene: 开盖先看有无溢漏破管
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an open centrifuge with a magnifier checking the rotor for leaks and broken tubes. No text.
shots.narration: 开盖先看：有没有破管、溢漏。

shots.section_title: 开盖查漏，破管不徒手
shots.scene: 发现破管，立即关盖静置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a broken tube spotted in the rotor, the lid closed again and a clock icon for waiting. No text.
shots.narration: 发现破管，先关盖，静置一会儿。

shots.section_title: 开盖查漏，破管不徒手
shots.scene: 戴手套用镊子夹碎片放锐器盒，徒手捡打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: gloved hands using forceps to pick broken tube pieces into a sharps container, a bare hand crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 戴手套用镊子夹碎片，绝不徒手捡。

shots.section_title: 开盖查漏，破管不徒手
shots.scene: 转子和腔体清洁消毒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rotor and centrifuge chamber being wiped clean, a disinfectant bottle icon beside. No text.
shots.narration: 离心机和转子彻底清洁，按规程消毒。

shots.section_title: 开盖查漏，破管不徒手
shots.scene: 想清楚怎么清理再动手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pauses with a blank procedure card, thinking before starting the cleanup.
shots.narration: 想清楚怎么清理，再动手。

shots.section_title: 感染性材料：密封离心，柜内装卸
shots.scene: 离心时气溶胶从管口逸出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: tiny invisible droplets escaping from an open tube inside a spinning rotor. No text.
shots.narration: 离心是气溶胶的常见来源。
overlay: 感染性材料：密封离心，柜内装卸

shots.section_title: 感染性材料：密封离心，柜内装卸
shots.scene: 先做风险评估，在相应防护级别实验室
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a risk assessment form and a laboratory door with a biohazard warning sign. No text.
shots.narration: 先评估风险，在相应级别实验室操作。

shots.section_title: 感染性材料：密封离心，柜内装卸
shots.scene: 密封管、密封转子或安全杯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sealed tube, a sealed rotor with an O ring lid and a capped safety cup. No text.
shots.narration: 用密封管和密封转子或安全杯。

shots.section_title: 感染性材料：密封离心，柜内装卸
shots.scene: 在生物安全柜里装管拧盖
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: gloved hands loading tubes into a safety cup and closing it inside a biosafety cabinet. No text.
shots.narration: 装管、拧盖，都在生物安全柜里。

shots.section_title: 感染性材料：密封离心，柜内装卸
shots.scene: 【实拍】在生物安全柜内打开密封转子盖（清水管模拟）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: gloved hands opening a sealed rotor lid inside a biosafety cabinet.
shots.narration: 离心后静置，回到安全柜里再打开。

shots.section_title: 感染性材料：密封离心，柜内装卸
shots.scene: 离心机放进安全柜，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a centrifuge running inside a biosafety cabinet disturbing the air curtain, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 离心机别放进安全柜里运行。

shots.section_title: 用后擦干登记，故障停用报告
shots.scene: 擦干腔体，开盖晾干
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cloth drying the centrifuge chamber and the lid left open to air dry. No text.
shots.narration: 用完擦干腔体，开盖晾干。
overlay: 用后擦干登记，故障停用报告

shots.section_title: 用后擦干登记，故障停用报告
shots.scene: 关机、登记、样品带走
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off the centrifuge, fills in the logbook and takes his samples away.
shots.narration: 关机、登记，样品带走。

shots.section_title: 用后擦干登记，故障停用报告
shots.scene: 破管、故障，挂牌报告负责人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an out of service tag on a centrifuge and a report going to the lab supervisor. No text.
shots.narration: 破管、故障，停用并报告负责人。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 选机、选管、配平、对称四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, a matched rotor, a matched tube, a balance scale and opposite tubes in a rotor. No text.
shots.narration: 选对机和管，配好平，对称放。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 拧紧盖、核转速、守全速三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a tightened rotor lid, a speed gauge and a person waiting beside a centrifuge. No text.
shots.narration: 拧紧盖，核转速，守到全速。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 停机、停稳开盖、密封杯三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a stop button, a zero speed display and a sealed safety cup. No text.
shots.narration: 异常就停，停稳开盖，感染性密封。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣拿着软刷站在转子旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a soft brush beside a clean rotor on a mat and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：离心机的维护与转子退役。
